bio: Tasty wholesome food crafted from top-notch local produce at eater-friendly prices: such is the pledge of the Lefèvre couple who runs this welcoming inn built out of local stone – formerly the village bar and grocery shop. A bright, trendy interior with a pleasant alfresco space for sunny days and a rotisserie in the hall that fills the dining room with the enticing aromas of dishes of the day such as chicken colombo....
